items.title: Live: Dubai airport targeted as Iran president apologises to neighbouring countries
items.description: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian has apologised to neighbouring countries for Iran's attacks across the region, saying that they would not be targeted unless attacks originated from them. Follow live.

items.title: If 'mini supreme leader' Mojtaba Khamenei rises to power it will send a message
items.description: As senior clerics responsible for selecting Iran's next supreme leader met this week to discuss their pick, a familiar name emerged as the frontrunner: Mojtaba Khamenei.

items.title: Iran's women's football team being held 'hostage' amid calls for them to remain in Australia
items.description: The Iranian women's football team is facing an impossible situation. Return home, and possibly face punishment from the Islamic Republic regime for its silent protest, or stay in Australia and their families could instead suffer retribution.

items.title: Gulf nations are worried about what Trump will leave behind
items.description: While the cabaret of outlandish and contradictory statements and claims continues in Washington, there is considerable pragmatic pessimism in the Gulf about the mess Donald Trump will leave behind.

items.title: Good Samaritan killed while trying to protect boy from group assault
items.description: Police say the 22-year-old man was stabbed to death while trying to protect a 14-year-old boy from a group attack at a train station in Melbourne's outer north.

items.title: Quick hits: Verstappen's big crash and Mercedes accused of sandbagging
items.description: Mercedes blitzed the competition in Melbourne, with McLaren's Oscar Piastri declaring the Silver Arrows had dropped the "sandbags" from their car. These are the key moments from qualifying at Albert Park.

items.title: 'I'm not a hero': Austin Appelbee reunited with rescuers who saved family
items.description: A WA family who made global headlines when they were rescued after being swept out to sea have been reunited with the local heroes who saved them.

items.title: Agricultural businessman to stand for One Nation in Farrer by-election
items.description: David Farley, 69, defeats two other candidates in today's preselection battle at the Albury Entertainment Centre.

items.title: The Catholic priest who quit over celibacy rules
items.description: Alberto Ravagnani quit the Catholic priesthood last month saying it was too difficult to remain celibate.

items.title: Superstar Sutherland backs up record-breaking ton with key wickets
items.description: An all-round masterclass by Annabel Sutherland has Australia on the brink of victory against India after day two of the day-night Test at the WACA.

items.title: Katherine 'under threat' as 'major flood' risk to remain until Sunday
items.description: Floodwater is entering parts of the Katherine town centre and overwhelming the town's levee system. The water level is expected to peak 19.2 metres later tonight, and will remain a "major flood risk" until Sunday evening.

items.title: Bulldogs beat the Lions in a thriller at the Gabba as Giants get revenge on Hawks
items.description: Defending premiers Brisbane Lions lose a thriller against the Bulldogs after an injury-hit GWS get revenge on the Hawks for an elimination final loss.

items.title: Raiders beat Manly in dramatic golden point season opener
items.description: Ethan Sanders boots a field goal to take the Raiders to a 29-28 victory over Manly in golden point at a sodden Brookvale Oval after last-second drama.

items.title: Media personality, broadcaster, and Agro puppeteer Jamie Dunn dies aged 76
items.description: Dunn was a long-standing host of the B105 breakfast program but was known across the country as Agro — a puppet made out of a bath mat that rose to fame in 1990s.

items.title: 'I'm not going to sit here and get killed': Trans lives in Trump's America
items.description: Since Donald Trump returned to power last year, trans Americans say they feel dehumanised, unsafe and isolated from public spaces. For some, Australia has provided a safe haven.

items.title: Embrace simplicity with baked eggplant and soy-garlic chicken mince
items.description: This dish is reminiscent of moussaka but it's a more pared-back meal that's not as rich and involves fewer steps.

items.title: Fans devastated over trouble in paradise for Kyle and Jackie O
items.description: An actress, electrician and real estate agent all have one thing in common – their love for Kyle and Jackie O. Here's why they've stuck by the pair through thick and thin.

items.title: We met a great wall of polite silence at China's National People's Congress
items.description: China gives foreign journalists one chance each year to speak with politicians. Here’s what happened when I tried.

items.title: Brisbane man drowns in surf on Sunshine Coast
items.description: A Brisbane man has died on the Sunshine Coast after he went missing in the surf on Saturday afternoon.

items.title: SA Liberals to preference One Nation over ALP as Bernardi comments condemned
items.description: South Australia's Liberal opposition will preference One Nation over Labor at the upcoming state election as parties condemn "outrageous" comments by One Nation's Cory Bernardi.

items.title: Community outrage as respected senior doctor escorted from hospital
items.description: Community outrage flares as a "respected and trusted" senior doctor is escorted from a regional hospital amid the fall-out from a controversial redevelopment project.

items.title: Labor on track to win Nightcliff by-election, taking NT's single Greens seat
items.description: Labor is on track to win the Nightcliff by-election, taking the Greens' first and only seat held in the Northern Territory parliament.

items.title: The 20-year search for the Nannup Four
items.description: In July 2007, Simon Kadwill, Tony Popic, Chantelle McDougall and her five-year-old daughter Leela vanished from an isolated WA town. Chantelle's parents have spent the better part of 20 years trying to work out how to live with what's happened, as a complex picture of deceit, coercive control and cult-like beliefs has come to light.

items.title: PNG military boss issues warning over Australian rifles after high-powered guns seized
items.description: The head of Papua New Guinea's military says the country does not have the capacity to safely store 3,500 rifles Australia plans to ship to the country, raising fears they could end up in the hands of tribal warlords.

items.title: China accuses Australia of 'distorting facts' about helicopters' encounter
items.description: The Australian Defence Force says a Seahawk helicopter launched from HMAS Toowoomba was confronted by a Chinese helicopter and forced to "take evasion to maintain a safe flight".
